reading-text-1.label: 阅读 Text 1
reading-text-1.title: 2026 考研英语二 阅读 Text 1

paragraphs.en: Ask people about public libraries and a certain image springs to mind: dusty, old-fashioned, the sort of place you enjoyed as a child but, rather like a British seaside town, would you go there now? And anyway—aren’t they all closing? The reality is startlingly different, as I discovered when the culture department commissioned me to conduct an independent review of English public libraries, published yesterday. As I visited libraries up and down the country, I was surprised to learn there are more than twice the number of libraries (2,892) as there are branches of McDonald’s.
paragraphs.zh: 当人们问起公共图书馆时，脑海中会浮现出一个特定的画面：尘土飞扬、老式，是你小时候喜欢去的地方，但更像是英国的海滨小镇，你现在还会去吗？而且，它们不是都关门了吗？但事实却大不相同，当文化部委托我对英国公共图书馆进行独立评估时，当我参观全国各地的图书馆时，我惊讶地发现，图书馆的数量（2,892个）是麦当劳分店的两倍多。

paragraphs.en: Enter any one of them and you will find a hive of activity. While books are, and should always be, at the heart of any library, a multitude of other services are offered: employment advice, language classes or digital access and support. There are libraries with business and intellectual property centres, which can help business owners and entrepreneurs. Many have nurses on site to carry out basic health checks, with a link to the GP’s surgery. There are libraries where young people can borrow a Fifa-standard football free.
paragraphs.zh: 进入其中任何一个图书馆，你都会发现一个活动的蜂巢。虽然书籍是，而且应该永远是，任何图书馆的核心，但也提供了许多其他服务：就业咨询，语言课程或数字访问和支持。有商业和知识产权中心的图书馆，可以帮助企业主和企业家。许多人都有护士现场进行基本的健康检查，有一个链接到全科医生的手术。有图书馆，年轻人可以借一个国际足联标准的足球免费。

paragraphs.en: In return for all of this, you’ll be asked for precisely nothing. There will be no charge and you will never be asked to justify or explain yourself; you will simply be welcomed in, offered help if you need it, and left alone if you do not. There is no other institution, public or private, that can say the same. Yet still our libraries are often overlooked and underappreciated. There is an overall decline in visits and many are struggling as local authorities come under continued financial pressure.
paragraphs.zh: 作为回报，你将不会被要求任何东西，不会有任何费用，也永远不会被要求为自己辩护或解释;你会受到欢迎，如果你需要帮助，就会提供帮助，如果你不需要，就不会有人打扰。没有其他机构，无论是公共的还是私人的，这也可以说是一样的。然而，我们的图书馆仍然经常被忽视和低估。访问量总体下降，许多图书馆在地方当局持续的财政压力下苦苦挣扎。

paragraphs.en: The number of libraries that have closed since 2010 is disputed. An annual survey by the Chartered Institute of Public Finance and Accountancy puts it at nearly 800 across the UK; official statistics held by the Arts Council record 230 in England. It is, of course, 230 libraries too many. So if we are to protect our libraries for future generations, we must raise awareness of them and the work they do.
paragraphs.zh: 自2010年以来关闭的图书馆数量一直存在争议，英国特许公共财政和会计学会的一项年度调查显示，英国有近800家图书馆关闭;根据艺术理事会的官方统计，英国有230个图书馆。当然，230个图书馆太多了。所以，如果我们要为子孙后代保护我们的图书馆，我们必须提高对他们和他们所做工作的认识。

paragraphs.en: The review recommends a national branding campaign to give libraries a stronger physical presence, the reintroduction of a scheme to enable members to use their card in any library in the country, and automatic memberships for children. If we don’t use them, we will end up losing them. And for those who haven’t been to a library for some time, they may be surprised by what they find.
paragraphs.zh: 这篇评论建议开展一场全国性的品牌宣传活动，让图书馆拥有更强大的实体存在，重新引入一项计划，使会员能够在全国任何图书馆使用他们的卡，并为儿童提供自动会员资格。如果我们不使用它们，我们最终会失去它们。对于那些有一段时间没有去过图书馆的人来说，他们可能会对他们的发现感到惊讶。

reading-text-2.label: 阅读 Text 2
reading-text-2.title: 2026 考研英语二 阅读 Text 2

paragraphs.en: According to our research, around one in five workers in the UK talk to AI like a friend, looking for guidance on personal and professional problems. Our data shows that engaging with AI like this can leave us feeling heard and less isolated. But, with this newfound connection, many of us share sensitive, sometimes highly confidential information, even though over a third of people don’t realise that AI platforms may not be very good at keeping our secrets... secret.
paragraphs.zh: 根据我们的研究，在英国，大约五分之一的员工像朋友一样与人工智能交谈，寻求个人和专业问题的指导。我们的数据显示，与人工智能这样接触可以让我们感到被倾听，不那么孤立。但是，通过这种新发现的联系，我们中的许多人分享敏感，有时高度机密的信息，尽管超过三分之一的人没有意识到人工智能平台可能不善于保守我们的秘密。

paragraphs.en: For businesses, the implications are worrying. Consider Microsoft Copilot, for example. It grants Microsoft broad rights to the data inputted or outputted by any user—rights to use this data in any way it sees fit; it can even share it with third parties. This means that any sensitive business information could potentially be exposed to the world. Employers are taking note and taking action. According to our research, 25% have decided to either outright ban AI or regulate its use within their organisations. But even with these policies in place, some employees choose to break the rules. They have their reasons—around 63% of them report that using AI increases their productivity, and some even feel AI offers more help than their human colleagues.
paragraphs.zh: 对于企业来说，这一影响令人担忧。以微软的Copilot为例，它赠款微软对任何用户输入或输出的数据的广泛权利--以任何它认为合适的方式使用这些数据的权利;它甚至可以与第三方共享。这意味着任何敏感的商业信息都可能暴露在世界各地。雇主正在注意并采取行动。根据我们的研究，25%的人决定要么彻底禁止人工智能，要么在组织内规范人工智能的使用。但即使有这些政策，一些员工还是选择打破规则。他们有自己的理由-其中约63%的人报告说，使用人工智能可以提高他们的生产力，有些人甚至认为人工智能比人类同事提供更多的帮助。

paragraphs.en: The situation presents a delicate balance between leveraging AI for its productivity gains and risking confidential data exposure. Employers need to manage AI tools with the same level of care as any other form of data sharing or storage. There’s also a knowledge gap that needs to be addressed—40% of individuals surveyed are unsure about who retains ownership over the content produced by AI. By instilling best practices in AI engagement and creating policies that evolve with the technology, businesses can positively shift the AI landscape.
paragraphs.zh: 这种情况在利用人工智能提高生产力和冒机密数据泄露风险之间呈现出微妙的平衡。雇主需要以与任何其他形式的数据共享或存储相同的谨慎程度来管理人工智能工具。还有一个需要解决的知识差距-40%的受访者不确定谁对人工智能制作的内容拥有所有权。通过在人工智能参与中灌输最佳实践并制定政策，随着技术的发展，企业可以积极地改变人工智能的格局。

paragraphs.en: With AI’s potential to simplify our professional lives, do the admin and enhance the work experience, it’s up to us to navigate its usage cautiously so it supports us without compromising our privacy. There’s no need to back away from progress, as long as we’re equipped with the knowledge and tools to make sure AI remains a friend. And this is where the challenge lies. There are so many products out there, being promoted with huge advertising and marketing budgets, that it’s easy to fall victim. But by building a culture of digital responsibility within our businesses, we can create a future where AI can help us without spilling the beans.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能有可能简化我们的职业生活，做管理工作，增强工作体验，因此我们有责任谨慎地使用它，以便在不损害我们隐私的情况下为我们提供支持。只要我们拥有知识和工具，确保人工智能仍然是朋友，就没有必要放弃进步。这就是挑战所在。有这么多产品，但是，通过在我们的企业中建立数字责任文化，我们可以创造一个人工智能可以帮助我们而不泄露秘密的未来。

reading-text-3.label: 阅读 Text 3
reading-text-3.title: 2026 考研英语二 阅读 Text 3

paragraphs.en: Since the 2008 launch of the high-speed rail network between Rome and Milan, trains have become the preferred means of travel across Italy for locals and tourists alike. Fast trains can cover the 500km between the two cities in three hours. The network also connects Naples, Bologna, Florence and Turin. In many cases, it is the best option—in terms of travel time and cost—for both leisure and business travellers.
paragraphs.zh: 自2008年罗马和米兰之间的高速铁路网开通以来，火车已经成为当地人和游客在意大利旅行的首选方式。快速列车可以在三小时内覆盖两个城市之间的500公里。该网络还连接那不勒斯，博洛尼亚，佛罗伦萨和都灵。在许多情况下，无论是消闲旅客或商务旅客，这条路线都是最佳的选择，无论是在旅行时间或费用方面。

paragraphs.en: This is why the recent severe delays caused by numerous maintenance works have thrown the rail industry into chaos at a time when most people head on holiday, which matters for business in a country where tourism accounts for 10 percent of GDP.
paragraphs.zh: 这就是为什么最近大量维修工程造成的严重延误使铁路行业陷入混乱，而大多数人都在度假，这对一个旅游业占GDP 10%的国家的商业来说很重要。

paragraphs.en: Disruptions have become increasingly frequent with train delays now a fixture in Italian media coverage. Ferrovie dello Stato Italiane, the publicly controlled group that owns train operator Trenitalia and the national train network RFI, said 23 percent of all high-speed trains it operated were late in 2023. The huge improvements in Italy’s obsolete infrastructure partly explained the disruption, said Ferrovie. RFI, the network operator, is the single largest European recovery fund beneficiary with planned investments of €24bn by 2026. Ferrovie will invest a total of €124bn in infrastructure over the next 10 years. But lack of capacity is another problem. Transport economist Andrea Giuricin said the planned investments would bring improvements but disruptions in the meantime were inevitable. “We have a mixed system, there is no spare capacity and as soon as there’s a hiccup on the line, the situation becomes highly complex,” he said. A mixed system means that high-speed trains must travel on the regular tracks on certain routes or when passing through large cities. If there’s congestion or, for example, a local train breaks down, the entire high-speed network is affected.
paragraphs.zh: 随着火车延误现在成为意大利媒体报道的固定内容，中断变得越来越频繁。拥有火车运营商Trenitalia和国家火车网络RFI的公共控制集团Ferrovie dello Stato Italiane表示，到2023年，其运营的所有高速列车中有23%晚点。Ferrovie说，意大利陈旧的基础设施的巨大改进部分解释了中断。网络运营商，是欧洲复苏基金的最大受益者，计划到2026年投资240亿欧元。未来10年，Ferrovie将在基础设施方面投资总计1240亿欧元。但运力不足是另一个问题。交通经济学家Andrea Giuricin表示，计划中的投资将带来改善，但同时中断是不可避免的。他说：”我们采用的是混合系统，没有多余的运力，一旦线路出现故障，情况就会变得非常复杂。“混合系统意味着高速列车必须在某些路线或经过大城市时在常规轨道上行驶。如果出现拥堵或当地列车故障，整个高速网络都会受到影响。

paragraphs.en: One of the most important changes the upgrades will bring is the segregation of the high-speed line from the regular one in certain urban centres through the construction of underground rail links.
paragraphs.zh: 升级将带来的最重要的变化之一是通过建造地下铁路连接将高速线路与某些城市中心的常规线路隔离开来。

paragraphs.en: Improvements will also come from the high-density technology and satellite signalling that RFI has been investing in for years, say experts. It will allow for a reduction of the distance between high-speed trains travelling on the same line at any given time, which should mean a significant increase in capacity and traffic fluidity, according to Giuricin.
paragraphs.zh: 专家们表示，RFI多年来一直在投资的高密度技术和卫星信号也将带来改进。Giuricin表示，这将缩短同一条线路上高速列车之间在任何给定时间行驶的距离，这意味着运力和交通流动性将大幅增加。

reading-text-4.label: 阅读 Text 4
reading-text-4.title: 2026 考研英语二 阅读 Text 4

paragraphs.en: In 2023, Chicago lost one of its most beloved street festivals. The Silver Room Block Party, staged by Hyde Park community leader Eric Williams, announced it would not return in 2024. What began as a small neighborhood gathering blossomed into a massive cultural event, welcoming tens of thousands of people each year over nearly two decades before abruptly shutting down. Williams pointed to rising production costs and declining attendee donations as primary reasons the Silver Room Block Party could not continue, highlighting a reality that all street festival organizers face right now. The cost of producing a street festival in Chicago has skyrocketed. Security, entertainment, portable restrooms, insurance and even basics such as fencing and staffing have all become significantly more expensive. At the same time, donations at festival gates have dropped dramatically.
paragraphs.zh: 2023年，芝加哥失去了它最受欢迎的街头节日之一。由海德公园社区领袖埃里克威廉姆斯举办的银房街区派对宣布，它将不会在2024年回归。最初是一个小型社区聚会，后来发展成为一个大型文化活动，在突然关闭之前的近二十年里，每年都有成千上万的人前来参观。威廉姆斯指出，生产成本不断上升，参加者的捐款减少是银房街区派对无法继续的主要原因，这凸显了所有街头节日组织者目前面临的一个现实。在芝加哥举办街头节日的成本飙升。安保、娱乐、便携式洗手间、保险甚至围栏和员工等基本设施都变得更加昂贵。与此同时，节日门口的捐款急剧下降。

paragraphs.en: Chicago’s summer festivals are about more than just entertainment; they are economic engines that directly benefit the neighborhoods they’re in and the city of Chicago as whole. Street festivals drive foot traffic to local businesses and foster the kind of cultural vibrancy that makes our city special. We often hear people ask why we solicit donations at our entry points, especially when the city’s largest festivals like the Chicago Jazz Festival do not request donations. The fact is, unlike those large, city-produced music festivals, your neighborhood street festivals receive no city funding and rely on a combination of sponsorships, vendor fees and gate donations to cover their costs. Wicker Park Fest has long been one of Chicago’s most anticipated summer festivals, drawing upward of 70,000 attendees for a full weekend of live indie music, local art, small business vendors and, most importantly, community connection. In 2024, Wicker Park Fest saw record-breaking attendance. Despite the turnout, gate donations reached their lowest point in our history. This year, we’ve been forced to scale back the footprint of the fest. We are eliminating a stage, booking fewer performers and making additional cuts to reduce our costs, all while striving to keep the festival as vibrant as ever, as supportive of local artists and businesses, and as true to Wicker Park’s unique spirit and reputation as festgoers have come to expect.
paragraphs.zh: 芝加哥的夏季节日不仅仅是娱乐;他们是经济引擎，直接造福于他们所在的社区和整个芝加哥。街头节日为当地企业带来了客流量，并培养了使我们的城市与众不同的文化活力。我们经常听到人们问为什么我们在入口处募捐，特别是当城市最大的节日，如芝加哥爵士音乐节不要求捐款。事实是，不像那些大型的，城市生产的音乐节，你的社区街道节日没有得到城市的资金，并依赖于一个组合的奖学金，Wicker Park Fest一直是芝加哥最受期待的夏季节日之一，整个周末吸引了超过70，000名参与者，现场独立音乐，当地艺术，小企业供应商，最重要的是，社区联系。在2024年，Wicker Park Fest的出席人数破了纪录。尽管出席人数众多，但门票捐赠达到了我们历史上的最低点。今年，我们被迫缩减了节日的足迹。我们取消了一个舞台，预订了更少的表演者，并进行了额外的削减以降低成本，同时努力保持节日一如既往的活力，支持当地艺术家和企业，并忠实于柳条公园独特的精神和声誉，正如节日游客所期望的那样。

paragraphs.en: This summer, as you enjoy your favorite neighborhood street festival, I hope you’ll remember that they exist because of community support. A thriving summer festival season doesn’t happen by accident; it happens when we all chip in.
paragraphs.zh: 今年夏天，当您享受您最喜欢的社区街道节日时，我希望您记住它们的存在是因为社区的支持。蓬勃发展的夏季节日季节不会偶然发生;当我们都参与其中时，它就会发生。
